description: The governed runtime for agent skills: explicit skills, bounded authority, gated actions, and a signed receipt for every run.
rules: A skill is a SKILL.md contract; its execution profile is a run.yaml; a graph is a graph.yaml.
Read a skill before running it: its manifest, the authority it requests, and its trust tier.
Grant the narrowest authority the skill declares it needs, never a broader scope for convenience.
Consequential actions pass through a gate; treat the signed receipt as the record of what ran, not the console output.
Install with the CLI from https://runx.ai/install and discover skills at https://runx.ai/x or over MCP at https://api.runx.ai/mcp.
